nodes.text:
Yicai reported that recent data from the Chinese CDC reveals a continued rise in acute respiratory infections nationwide. Flu-like cases in emergency departments show respiratory samples mainly testing positive for influenza virus, rhinovirus, and human metapneumovirus (hMPV). The positivity rate of hMPV is also trending upward, especially in children under 14. Northern provinces report a more significant increase.
